methodology.opponent: authored commander-v1 under the mission rival mask
methodology.utility: opponent Town Center HP lost / initial opponent maximum HP - own Town Center HP lost / initial own maximum HP + 0.02 * completed recruited soldiers
methodology.damage_measurement: Net Town Center HP loss over the window; total combat damage is not instrumented.
methodology.unfinished_outcome: A playing match at the horizon remains unfinished, with no invented winner.
methodology.selection: No selection occurs in this evaluator. The programs file is captured before simulations; use development/validation to freeze a test candidate.
methodology.inference_unit: world seed; one blue-side paired intervention per candidate and seed

programs.source: Exact authored commander-v1 baseline; no parameter edits.
Only shared output bias shifted by one; behavioral negative control.
